title: 関係行政論
subtitle: Legal and Administrative Systems
keywords: Certified Psychologist Law 2.Psychiatric Social Worker Law 3.Child Walfare Law 4.Law for People with Disabilities 5.Eldery Walfare Law
educationalGoal: Certified psychologists are expected to work in a variety of fields. They are expected to understand many laws and systems related to that field. The goal of this course is to provide an opportunity to deepen understanding of the laws and systems that are important when working in various fields through specific examples.
advice: In the class, the Certified Psychologist Act will be introduced first. After that, we will cover laws and systems in each of the six fields: health and medical care, welfare, education, justice and crime, and industry and labor. Each field is subdivided into several sections to deepen understanding. In each session, students will be asked to think about how to utilize the laws and systems they have learned through group work based on cases that certified psychologists are likely to encounter, so active participation is expected.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
